objectClass.notes: Treat as an object-scale render asset. Hidden elevations are explicit approximations; map coordinates and collision remain external source truth.

reasoning: The identity depends on five interlocking macro masses rather than one building box.
The red folded tower and white gallery cantilevers must remain separate clickable/explodable parts.
Repeated ribs, mullions, louvers, doors, and panel seams require deterministic repetition systems.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Choose simple/moderate/complex/ultra-complex from observed structure, not from a hardcoded domain.

resolvedUnknowns.decision: Rear and camera-right elevations may continue only the visible massing and material-band grammar; they are presentation approximations, not surveyed architecture.
All dimensions are normalized image-derived proportions. World placement may apply one uniform scale, but this evidence makes no measured-dimension or map-truth claim.
Use the visible crown silhouette as the termination and keep hidden roof detail deliberately plain; no unseen plant or facade modules are invented.
Treat the RGB halo outside the admitted alpha silhouette as source presentation lighting only; exclude it from geometry and albedo evidence.

definitionOfDone: The five committed runtime groups remain independently named and selectable: sfmoma.darkPodium, sfmoma.galleryStack, sfmoma.redTower, sfmoma.glassSystems, and sfmoma.architecturalDetails.
The reference view preserves the asymmetric gallery stack, recessed podium entry, red folded tower with glazed slot, and horizontal curtain-wall bands without claiming surveyed dimensions.
Ribs, mullions, door frames, louvers, panel seams, stair treads, guards, and parapets use deterministic repetition or named feature groups rather than prose-only intent.
Pale concrete and red cladding expose independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO evidence channels; the evidence remains explicitly single-image inference.
Neutral, grazing, reference, side, and rear-orbit captures remain required before any visual completion claim; hidden elevations are accepted approximations.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage, branch, limb, handle, connector, tube, cable, horn, wing, leg, or hinged part has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.
Important materials define independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO responses instead of reusing one texture for unrelated PBR channels.
Surface response is decomposed into macro, meso, and micro frequency bands with scale and amplitude tied to object scale.
failureModes: local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
When a source image is available, run reference PBR extraction and require confidence >= 0.7 before treating maps as implementation-ready.
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
Neutral, grazing-angle, and reference-matched renders prove that surface relief survives relighting and is not painted into albedo.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.

screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

actionReadiness.contract: The spec targets the committed SFMOMA factory hierarchy by exact runtime node name. This records intended targeting metadata only; build, part-coverage, clickability, explodability, and sculptRuntime remain unproven gates.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Preserve exactly one root named SFMOMA generated landmark v1.
Preserve the five committed child-group names sfmoma.darkPodium, sfmoma.galleryStack, sfmoma.redTower, sfmoma.glassSystems, and sfmoma.architecturalDetails.
Keep transforms on named component groups so a later picker or explode system can target semantic groups without traversing anonymous meshes.
Treat all five architectural groups as static and non-breakable until part-coverage and action-ready gates provide runtime evidence.
Use compound box colliders as future intent only; this spec does not certify collision geometry or map coordinates.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: The admitted source is a single isolated concept view; rear and camera-right elevations are accepted presentation approximations with confidence 0.55.
All component dimensions are normalized proportions inferred from the reference and are not surveyed SFMOMA dimensions, EPSG:26910 coordinates, or source truth.
The committed factory's top-level node names are read from src/citygen/landmarks/sfmoma-generated-v1.js; this spec records parity but does not claim the factory was generated from this repaired spec.
The reference-wide PBR extraction is single-image evidence capped at 0.86 confidence; material-specific values remain bounded inference and require neutral/grazing render review.
The transparent RGB halo is excluded from albedo and geometry because reference admission identifies it as presentation background.

proceduralStrategy: Keep one root plus the five exact committed factory groups; model gallery volumes as independent rounded boxes and the red tower as closed extruded folded profiles.
Use deterministic InstancedMesh arrays for 40 tower facade elements, curtain-wall mullions, four entry doors, 12 louvers, and concrete seam relief.
Separate pale concrete, red cladding, red facade elements, charcoal metal, blue-gray glass, and warm interior backing into six material contracts.
Keep albedo, roughness, height, normal, and AO paths independent; reference-wide extraction is bounded single-image evidence, never exact physical recovery.
Treat hidden elevations as plain continuation approximations and require side/rear orbit review before any build-completion claim.
Do not generate, regenerate, or claim build/review gates in this spec-repair stage.
animationAnchors: root pivot node supports whole-object translation, rotation, scale, and visibility changes
component pivot groups support later local transforms without rebuilding geometry
destructionAnchors: actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup marks detachable or breakable component sets
component seams and sockets define plausible break points instead of random explosions
risks: Single-view hidden elevations remain approximate and may differ substantially from the real museum.
Normalized factory dimensions are presentation proportions, not surveyed dimensions or EPSG:26910 map truth.
Reference-wide PBR evidence spans multiple facade materials; per-material crops would be required before exact material matching could be claimed.
The committed factory exposes named groups but the action-ready and part-coverage runtime gates remain pending until sculptRuntime, clickability, and exploded-layout evidence exist.
